findings.message: ByTitle now builds the SQL query by concatenating the user-supplied term directly into the statement (WHERE title = '<term>') and executes it without parameters. This reintroduces a SQL injection vulnerability; any caller can inject arbitrary SQL via the search term.
findings.suggestion: Revert to parameterized queries: query := "SELECT id, sku, title FROM products WHERE title = $1"; rows, err := s.db.Query(query, term)
